data.indexCnDesc: 中证全指金融地产指数选取中证全指指数样本中属于金融和房地产两个中证一级行业的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映中证全指指数样本中金融和房地产上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI All Share Financials and Real Estate Index consists of securities from Financials sector and Real Estate sector of CSI All Share Index with large market-cap and good liquidity. The index is to measure the performance of Financials sector and Real Estate sector.
